name: Bitfocus Companion (HTTP)
hint: write the button as page/row/column, for example 1/2/3. visual.button presses and releases it; visual.button_down and visual.button_up hold and let go
notes: Companion's HTTP button API as remembered from its documentation: POST /api/location/<page>/<row>/<column>/press, and /down and /up for the two halves. It is the route Companion 3 documents; Companion 2 used a different one (GET /press/bank/<page>/<button>) that this profile does not send. Companion's web port is 8000 by default. Not checked against a running Companion, so confirm the path in your version's own documentation before a show. There is no TLS and no authentication header.
